text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $81k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum slightly outpaced it with modest gains, suggesting a lack of conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (50) and has declined 13 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling from recent peaks. Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 59.4% with moderate volume ($63B), reflecting a consolidation phase where participants are neither aggressively accumulating nor distributing.
